INSTALLER COMMISSIONING RECORD - 14 ALDER CLOSE
The air-source heat pump was commissioned on 14 March 2023 and the gas boiler was
capped the same day. The gas supply stays connected for the cooker only.
Rated heat output 7 kW. Measured flow on the heating cir-
cuit: 18 litres per minute at a flow temperature of 45 degrees Celsius.
